note: What a server sends to lay out everything a champion brought to the match: the runes set before it began, its summoner slots and the choices made alongside them. The header names the unit this is about.

revisions.note: A client shows the champion's icon and sets its two summoner slots from summoners.

fields.name: runes
fields.note: The runes set before the match.

items.name: rune
items.note: One rune, by the number the client knows it as.

fields.name: summoners
fields.note: The spells in the champion's summoner slots, by the numbers their names give.

items.name: summoner
items.note: One spell. Zero leaves the slot as it was.

fields.name: choices
fields.note: The choices made alongside them, 400 bytes that a client keeps as one block.

fields.name: level
fields.note: The player's account level.

revisions.note: A client's shop is set up by the Loadout of its own champion: until that arrives the shop opens empty, with no items, no suggested items and no builds, and is drawn at a size that does not fit the screen. A server sends one for every champion at spawning, between SpawnStart and SpawnEnd.
